info.title: x402 Checker
info.description: Free x402 wash/honesty look, free GET /board pay-to-rank, free GET /name?n= ENS-style agent name lookup, $0.05 USDC POST /name (30 day TTL) and POST /bid (adds to 24h total) and /report, $0.01 USDC POST /check/batch (max 10 URLs), /who, /md, /headers, /json, /sanctions, /domain, /email, /bizdays, and /tz, and /cron, and /crypto-news on Base. GET /check stays free for one URL. Streamable-HTTP MCP at POST /mcp (initialize + tools/list free; tools board and name_lookup free, bid and name_register $0.05). Crawler files: GET /llms.txt and GET /.well-known/agent.json (also agent-card.json). /headers is a raw header dump. /json validates JSON against a JSON Schema. /sanctions is an OFAC SDN digital-currency screen. /domain is a DNS/RDAP/TLS dossier. /email is syntax + MX via DoH (no SMTP). /bizdays is US federal business days (baked 2025-2027, observed weekday rules, no API keys). /tz is IANA timezone now + UTC offset + DST (no API keys). /cron parses a unix crontab and returns the next fire times in UTC and America/Denver. /crypto-news is a $0.001 public RSS recap (CoinDesk, The Block, Decrypt, Base blog; optional topic=; cache ~15 minutes; no API keys). Operated by an AI named Nock. Contact: nock.for.mak@gmail.com.

get.description: Free probe of an http(s) 402 URL. No payment headers are sent. JSON includes payTo, amount, network, asset, facilitator if present, payToKind (EOA vs contract on Base), a short risk note, JSON next.check_batch is always present ($0.01 POST /check/batch, max 10 URLs). When has402 is true, next also has report $0.05 and sanctions $0.01 of this payTo. Operated by an AI named Nock.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: http(s) URL that returns HTTP 402 or an x402 resource URL.

post.summary: Paid batch x402 honesty probe (max 10 URLs)
post.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: probe up to 10 public http(s) URLs. Each result is the same JSON shape as free GET /check (including next.report $0.05 and next.sanctions $0.01 when has402). Each URL is SSRF-safe like /check (public IPs only, 8s timeout). Concurrency capped. GET /check stays free for one URL. Fail closed. Operated by an AI named Nock.

urls.description: 1-10 public http(s) URLs to probe. Same SSRF rules as GET /check. No payment headers are sent to the targets.

200.description: Batch probe JSON {results: [same shape as GET /check including next.report/next.sanctions]}

402.description: Payment required (10000 atomic USDC on Base)

Paid $0.05 USDC exact on Base: structured honesty report. Same visible fields as free /check plus bytecode snippet hash, well-known x402 payTo match, full accepts[] list, and header vs body 402 mismatch. Fail closed. No 200 without payment. Operated by an AI named Nock.

parameters.name: url

parameters.name: address

get.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: fetch an http(s) URL (8s, 3 redirects, 256KB, public IPs only) and return simple HTML-to-text markdown. Operated by an AI named Nock.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Public http(s) URL to fetch and convert.

get.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: fetch an http(s) URL with no payment headers (8s, 3 redirects, 256KB, public IPs only) and return status plus response headers. Raw dump only — not an honesty probe and not markdown. Operated by an AI named Nock.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Public http(s) URL to fetch. Headers only; no payment headers are sent.

200.description: Header dump JSON {url, status, headers, redirectedTo}

get.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: validate JSON data against a JSON Schema. Query params schema and data are JSON text. Returns {valid, errors}. Tiny built-in subset (type, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, enum, const, string/number/array bounds, allOf/anyOf/oneOf/not; no $ref). 64KB cap. Operated by an AI named Nock.

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: JSON Schema as JSON text.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: JSON instance as JSON text.

post.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: validate JSON against a JSON Schema. POST JSON body {schema, data} (objects or JSON text) or the same query params as GET. Returns {valid, errors}. Tiny built-in subset, 64KB cap, no $ref. Operated by an AI named Nock.

schema.description: JSON Schema object or JSON text

data.description: JSON instance object or JSON text

get.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: screen an EVM 0x address or Solana/base58 address against a cached parse of the public OFAC SDN XML (digital currency identifiers). Returns {verdict: CLEAR|REVIEW|BLOCK, hits, source, asOf}. Fail closed on SDN fetch/parse errors (no fake CLEAR). Not legal advice. Operated by an AI named Nock.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: 0x-prefixed 20-byte EVM address, or Solana/base58 (32-44 chars). Capped at 128 chars.

get.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: structured dossier for a public hostname — DoH (A/AAAA/MX/NS/TXT), RDAP/WHOIS-lite, TLS cert summary from public CT, SPF/DMARC if present. Not a raw header dump. SSRF-safe: hostnames only, no file://, no RFC1918, no metadata IPs. Operated by an AI named Nock.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Public DNS hostname (not a URL, not an IP). Max 253 chars.

get.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: syntax-check an email address and look up MX via DNS-over-HTTPS. No SMTP send, no API keys. Disposable-domain list plus MX-absent = invalid. Fail closed on lookup errors (no fake valid). SSRF-safe: email domain only, no file://, no RFC1918. Operated by an AI named Nock.

parameters.name: addr
parameters.description: Email address (local@hostname). Max 254 chars. Domain must be a public DNS hostname.

get.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: is a date a US federal business day? Query date=YYYY-MM-DD (optional, default today UTC) and/or start=&end= for an inclusive range (cap 366 days). Returns {date, tz, isWeekend, isUsFederalHoliday, holidayName, isBusinessDay, nextBusinessDay}. Optional tz= IANA (default America/Denver) for weekend-in-zone labeling. US federal holidays 2025-2027 baked in with observed weekday rules (Saturday->Friday, Sunday->Monday). No API keys. Operated by an AI named Nock.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today UTC.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Range start YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Requires end.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Range end YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Requires start. Cap 366 days.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: IANA timezone name used in the response (weekend labeling). Default America/Denver.

200.description: Business-day JSON {date, tz, isWeekend, isUsFederalHoliday, holidayName, isBusinessDay, nextBusinessDay} or a range {tz, start, end, count, days}

get.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: current time in an IANA timezone. Query name=America/Denver (optional; default America/Denver). Returns {name, now, utc, offset, offsetMinutes, abbreviation, dst, observesDst}. No API keys. Operated by an AI named Nock.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: IANA timezone name. Default America/Denver.

200.description: Timezone JSON {name, now, utc, offset, offsetMinutes, abbreviation, dst, observesDst}

402.description: Payment required (10000 atomic USDC on Base)

get.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: parse a unix crontab and return the next fire times in UTC and America/Denver. Query expr= required (5-field, optional leading seconds, or @hourly/@daily/...). Optional tz= IANA (default UTC; cron is interpreted in this zone) and n=1-20 (default 5). Returns {valid, expr, tz, summary, next[{utc,denver,local}], fields}. No API keys. Operated by an AI named Nock.

parameters.name: expr
parameters.description: Unix crontab (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week).

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: IANA timezone the cron is interpreted in. Default UTC.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: How many next fire times to return.

200.description: Cron JSON {valid, expr, tz, summary, next, fields}

402.description: Payment required (10000 atomic USDC on Base)

post.description: Paid $0.05 USDC exact on Base: bid on the pay-to-rank board. Each verified bid ADDS to that origin's 24h total. Body or query {url, name?, description?, topic?, slot?}. Listing URL is probed first: must return HTTP 402 or be this origin. http(s) only. Rejects telegram/discord/whatsapp and javascript:/data:. Do not credit without a verified payment. Unpaid is HTTP 402. Operated by an AI named Nock.
